data.gender_notes: Ewold is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old German elements ew, meaning 'wealth' and wald, meaning 'rule'. This name was given to a child born into a prosperous family or to one expected to rule over great wealth. The name Ewold carries the meaning “Wealth ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ewold usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The Old German name 'Ewold' signifies a noble descendant from a wealthy family or someone destined to rule over vast riches. As a cultural impact, this name represented societal status and wealth among the Germanic people. It embodied the spirit of achievement, success, and the accumulation of material fortune.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance behind the name 'Ewold' lies in its Old German origins. The name not only symbolizes wealth and power but also emphasizes the concept of stewardship. Prosperity and riches, as represented by the name, were intended to be used responsibly and justly, ensuring the welfare of the community and those in need. Thus, the name 'Ewold' can be viewed as a reminder to use God-given gifts and resources to make a positive impact on others and serve the greater good.
